name: ELEX Woo Choose Your Delivery and Pickup Date
author: ELEXtensions

sections.description:
Allowing your customers to choose their preferred delivery and pickup dates directly at checkout is an effective way to enhance customer satisfaction, streamline order fulfillment, and reduce cart abandonment. The ELEX Woo Choose Your Delivery and Pickup Date plugin enables shoppers to specify exactly when they wish to receive or pick up their orders, accommodating customers who may be traveling or unavailable on standard delivery days.

This plugin is ideal for stores offering scheduled deliveries, local pickups, pre-orders, subscriptions, or gift items. As a store administrator, you maintain complete control over operational scheduling: configure minimum preparation lead times, define operating hours, select active working days, block weekly holidays, and manage specific date closures to ensure orders are accepted only when your store is operational.

Key Features

  • Flexible Date Selection: Enables shoppers to choose their preferred home delivery or local pickup date at checkout.
  • Lead Time Controls: Enforce a minimum delay (in days) required to prepare and process orders before delivery or pickup is allowed.
  • Working Hours & Weekday Schedule: Define daily store operating hours and specify which weekdays are available for scheduling.
  • Store Holidays & Closures: Easily add specific closure dates to block orders on holidays or maintenance days.
  • Maximum Daily Order Limits: Set maximum daily caps for delivery and pickup orders to prevent capacity overload.
  • Custom Customer Notifications: Display personalized notes or instructions directly on the checkout page.
  • Google Calendar Synchronization: Automatically sync scheduled orders with Google Calendar (optional opt-in feature).
  • WooCommerce Blocks & HPOS Ready: Fully compatible with WooCommerce Block Checkout and High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).

For technical support or assistance, please visit ELEX Support.

About ELEXtensions

External Services

This plugin optionally connects to Google APIs to sync WooCommerce delivery and pickup order dates with the store owner’s Google Calendar. This feature is entirely opt-in — it is only active when the store admin explicitly sets up and authorizes the Google Calendar integration from the plugin settings.

Service: Google OAuth 2.0 (accounts.google.com)

Used to authenticate and authorize the store admin’s Google account so the plugin can access their Google Calendar.

  • Endpoint: https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth
  • What is sent: The store admin’s Google Client ID, the plugin’s redirect URI, and requested OAuth scopes (calendar.events, userinfo.email, userinfo.profile).
  • When it is sent: Only when the store admin clicks “Authorize & Connect” in the plugin settings page.
  • Data is sent to Google’s servers and is subject to Google’s policies.

Service: Google OAuth 2.0 Token Exchange (oauth2.googleapis.com)

Used to exchange the authorization code for access and refresh tokens, and to refresh expired access tokens.

  • Endpoint: https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token
  • What is sent: The authorization code (or refresh token), the store admin’s Client ID and Client Secret.
  • When it is sent: Once after the admin authorizes the app, and automatically in the background when the access token expires to maintain the connection.
  • The access token and refresh token are stored encrypted in the WordPress database and are never shared with any party other than Google.

Service: Google OAuth 2.0 Token Revocation (oauth2.googleapis.com)

Used to revoke the stored access token when the admin disconnects their Google account.

  • Endpoint: https://oauth2.googleapis.com/revoke
  • What is sent: The current access token.
  • When it is sent: Only when the store admin clicks “Disconnect Account” in the plugin settings page.

Service: Google UserInfo API (googleapis.com)

Used to retrieve the connected Google account’s email address to display in the plugin settings.

  • Endpoint: https://www.googleapis.com/oauth2/v2/userinfo
  • What is sent: The OAuth access token (as a Bearer header).
  • When it is sent: Once after a successful authorization, to store and display the connected account email.

Service: Google Calendar API (googleapis.com)

Used to create, update, and delete calendar events on the store admin’s primary Google Calendar when WooCommerce orders are placed, updated, or cancelled — if the Google Calendar sync option is enabled.

  • Endpoint: https://www.googleapis.com/calendar/v3/calendars/primary/events
  • What is sent: Order delivery/pickup date, time slot, order ID, and customer name. No payment or sensitive personal data is sent.
  • When it is sent: When an order is placed, its status changes, or it is cancelled — only if Google Calendar sync is enabled in the plugin settings.

Google’s Legal Policies:

  • Terms of Service: https://policies.google.com/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
  • Google API Services User Data Policy: https://developers.google.com/terms/api-services-user-data-policy
sections.installation:
1. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard.
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New and upload the plugin zip file, or copy the plugin folder into /wp-content/plugins/.
  3. Click Activate Plugin.
  4. Access the plugin settings page under WooCommerce > Settings > ELEX Choose Your Delivery and Pickup Date Plugin.
sections.faq:
How do I enable delivery date selection at checkout?

Go to WooCommerce > Settings > ELEX Choose Your Delivery and Pickup Date Plugin > General Settings. Ensure the delivery options are configured, set any mandatory fields if desired, and click Save changes.

How do I set a minimum lead time for order preparation?

In the plugin settings under Store Availability, check Set Lead Time and enter the minimum number of days required before a delivery or pickup date can be selected by a customer.

Can I block specific store holidays or non-working days?

Yes. You can uncheck non-working days under Select Your Working Days and add specific date closures under Store Holidays. Dates listed as holidays will be disabled on the checkout calendar.

Does this plugin support local pickup locations?

Yes. Enable Pickup Service under the Pickup tab in the plugin settings. You can configure custom pickup store locations with addresses, contact details, operating hours, and location-specific lead times.
